prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 6 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, Night, warm lamp and pendant light.
Image 1: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: The pale linen sofa sits on the patterned rug in front of the single marble-and-glass coffee table, with the open kitchen and its white island behind and the floor lamp beside the sofa. Lin Qingyu sits slouched on the pale sofa. Ji Ran stands on the far side of the marble-and-glass coffee table, opposite him and facing the sofa, with her arms folded. The camera stays at the floor-lamp end of the sofa, seeing both across the coffee table.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in, eye-level, from the floor-lamp end of the sofa. Lin Qingyu sits slouched on the pale sofa, and Ji Ran stands across the marble-and-glass coffee table from him with her arms folded and city lights in the windows behind.
Panel 2: Medium shot, low angle from sofa height, locked-off camera, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran looks down at Lin Qingyu with her arms folded and one eyebrow raised.
Panel 3: Medium shot, slight high angle, handheld, on Lin Qingyu on the sofa. Lin Qingyu sits up straight on the sofa and lifts his eyes to meet Ji Ran's.
Panel 4: Close-up, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, eye-level. Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran's gaze with a sincere, steady look and a hint of a smile.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran's lips part slightly, and her folded arms loosen a little.
Panel 6: Wide shot, slow pull out, eye-level, from the floor-lamp end of the sofa. Soft glowing light and snowlike flecks drift across the image as Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu look at each other across the coffee table.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
